name: price_channel_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index closes above its 10-minute Donchian upper band with a volume surge, it signals that institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms working directional buy-side flows have overcome a meaningful intraday resistance level — the highest high of the prior 120 five-second bars. Stop-loss orders from short participants clustered just above this level are triggered, accelerating the initial push, while new momentum-following algos join the move. The closing above VWAP confirms the breakout is institutional-demand-driven rather than a momentary spike, making a 10-20 spot point continuation over the next 30-90 seconds structurally likely. The symmetric downside setup applies for Donchian lower-band breaks below VWAP — forced covering of resting buy stops amplifies the initial leg.

indicators.name: dc_upper_120
indicators.purpose: 10-minute rolling high (120 × 5s bars). NOT 12x scaling of the original 30-bar lookback (which would give 360 bars = 30 min). Chosen because 10-minute micro-consolidations are the most meaningful intraday resistance levels on NIFTY where institutional algo orders cluster. Shorter windows (2-5 min = 24-60 bars) are too noisy — breakouts happen frequently but reverse just as fast. Longer windows (30 min = 360 bars) give too few signals for a 90-second hold strategy.

indicators.name: dc_lower_120
indicators.purpose: Symmetric 10-minute rolling low for bearish breakout detection. Same rationale as dc_upper_120.

indicators.name: dc_width_pct
indicators.purpose: Channel width as % of spot price. Must exceed 0.15% (~33 NIFTY pts) to ensure the consolidation is real and not noise-level chop. Breakouts from <0.15% ranges are false positives at 5s resolution.

indicators.name: volume_ratio_20
indicators.purpose: 20-bar (100-second) volume ratio. The 20-bar window captures whether the breakout bar has abnormally high flow versus the prior ~1.5 minutes of activity — short enough to detect transient volume spikes while smoothing 5s noise.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(typical_price * volume) / cumulative(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP (no lookback — cumulative). Breakout above DC upper AND above VWAP confirms institutional buy-side demand. Breakout above DC upper but below VWAP may be a fakeout as VWAP-tracking algos would be selling against the price.

conditions: close > dc_upper_120[t-1]  (close breaks above prior bar's 10-min channel high)
close > vwap  (price above institutional benchmark — confirms direction)
dc_width_pct > 0.15  (channel wide enough to distinguish from noise)
(close - low) / (high - low) > 0.70  (strong close — top 30% of bar range)
close < dc_lower_120[t-1]  (close breaks below prior bar's 10-min channel low)
close < vwap  (price below institutional benchmark — confirms direction)
dc_width_pct > 0.15  (channel wide enough to distinguish from noise)
(close - low) / (high - low) < 0.30  (weak close — bottom 30% of bar range)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. Breakout failures on NIFTY reverse quickly — if price re-enters the channel within 30s, the institutional bid at the breakout level has been absorbed and the thesis is invalidated; 8 spot points is the typical retracement depth before the thesis is structurally broken.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. Successful NIFTY Donchian breakouts typically extend 15-25 spot points from the channel before the first significant pullback; 14 pts captures ~60% of the typical first leg extension at a 1:1.75 R:R ratio.

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX not required; channel width filter implicitly handles low-volatility no-breakout regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST (skip first 15 min to allow 10-min DC to populate with meaningful data)
filters.trend_filter: close vs VWAP alignment (built into entry conditions)
filters.spread_filter: none (limit orders at candle close, spread=0)

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — Donchian breakout is a well-known pattern but the 5-second execution with volume+VWAP filter and strong-close confirmation reduces false positive rate vs naive channel breakout

adaptation_notes: Original was NIFTY200 equity stocks at 1-minute bars with 30-minute channel (30 bars), 15-45 minute hold. Key changes: (1) Lookback compressed from 30 min to 10 min (120 bars) — not 12x scaled. At 5s with 90s hold, 10-min channel captures the micro-resistance levels NIFTY forms before institutional breakouts, while 30-min would fire too rarely. (2) Volume confirmation preserved but SMA window shortened from 20 bars (20 min) to 20 bars (100s) to match 5s timeframe. (3) DC_width_pct threshold lowered from 0.3% to 0.15% — index is smoother than stocks, meaningful consolidations can be tighter. (4) Stop changed from DC_mid (variable) to fixed 4 option pts for consistent risk management at 5s resolution. (5) Hold time compressed from 15-45 min to 30-90 sec — we're only riding the initial breakout impulse, not the full trend.
weaknesses: NIFTY channel breakouts have higher false positive rate in range-bound macro sessions (post-RBI, pre-budget) when algorithms are not directionally positioned
Volume ratio on 5s NIFTY index data is noisier than on equity stocks — single large block trades can spike the ratio without real momentum
10-minute channel on 5s bars requires 600 rows of warmup; early-session signals (09:30-09:40) will have insufficient DC data

_source.original_target: DC_width projected from breakout point (measured move)
